customer.business: May11Leven Labs, a small design studio (brand identity, websites, apps, 3D, automation, AI agents, content) that markets itself on Instagram
customer.target: Owners and marketing leads of growing businesses that sell on looks and trust: hotels and lodges, real estate, clinics, restaurants and cafes, fashion and beauty brands, schools
customer.where: Kenya, Rwanda, Tanzania, Uganda, Nigeria, Ghana, South Africa first; UAE and Saudi Arabia second; anywhere else third. Scrolling Instagram on a phone.

segments.name: Growing business owner or founder (10-50 staff)
Marketing lead at an established company

behaviours.name: Busy scroller
behaviours.how: Scrolls between tasks, stops only for something instantly clear.

behaviours.name: Design-aware
behaviours.how: Follows studios, saves nice work, compares feeds before hiring.

behaviours.name: Price-first
behaviours.how: Assumes good design is expensive, looks for the cheapest option.

behaviours.name: Has a designer already
behaviours.how: Works with a freelancer or a nephew who does logos.

behaviours.name: Trust-checker
behaviours.how: Wants proof: real clients, results, a local presence.

behaviours.name: Ready to rebrand
behaviours.how: Knows the brand looks dated and is actively looking.

pitch:
An Instagram carousel from May11Leven Labs, a design studio (5 slides):
Cover: the lowercase "a" of the Inter Tight typeface drawn as an outline with its anchor points and dashed guide lines (baseline, x-height, cap height) on cool grey.
Slide 2: type specimen "Quiet / work / that / sells." in three weights plus a serif italic.
Slide 3: the studio's two-bar "11" logo with measurements and "Two bars. One offset. The eleven, measured."
Slide 4: a photo-real render of the studio's own business card in an open brushed-steel case, with the 11 mark: the brand in use.
Slide 5: "People judge a business before they read a word. We measure the letters, the mark and the system so your brand looks as trustworthy as the work behind it. Brand identity, websites, apps, 3D, automation, AI agents and content. Comment 11 for a free first look at yours."
Caption opens: "every letter we set and every mark we draw is measured first." It also says: "people decide whether to trust a business before they read a word. that's why we measure first, so a brand looks as solid as the work behind it."
Ask: comment 11 for a free first look at your brand.
